1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __1500__ Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __divalent__ cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selected from the group consisting of__ polyethylenimine __and polypropylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, wherein said polyanion is __not exclusively__ sodium polyvinyl sulfonate.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium __, calcium, or zinc__ ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __is configured to have__ a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyalkylenimine is less than 1500 Da__. 

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle __capable of__ entrapping a multivalent cation.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, wherein __the composition is optimized for improved delivery__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with said composition__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate __wherein the polymer is selected based on __ specific application requirements. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where __the fluid is selected from the group consisting of__ brine or seawater __or other compatible aqueous solutions__.
